title: docs: installed plugin MCP servers connect in place, not at mcp.reload
claim: Docstrings, plugins/AGENTS.md and the plugin developer guide say a mid-run plugin's MCP servers wait for 'mcp.reload'; install surfaces connect them in place via load_and_go_live and report live_now.mcp_servers.

evidence.red: 'until ``mcp.reload``' at hermes_cli/plugins_activation.py:40 and hermes_cli/plugins_loader.py:196; plugins/AGENTS.md:70 '`deferred.mcp_servers` until `mcp.reload`'; website/docs/developer-guide/plugins/index.md:1585-1587 'connect on `mcp.reload` or the next session'; also gateway-internals.md:310 'wait for `mcp.reload`'.
evidence.green: All five places describe load_and_go_live connecting in place (live_now), with /reload-mcp or next session only where it did not run (messaging gateway); `git grep mcp.reload` in those files returns nothing.
evidence.negative_control: N/A for docs (no executable behaviour). Equivalent check: the stale phrase is present on main and absent on the bundle (grep given in red/green).
evidence.adjacent: python3 website/scripts/check_doc_links.py on the bundle tree: OK (no route-style links). All 7 B1 bundles cherry-pick together onto main cleanly, and each pairs cleanly with B2's current docs2-update/docs2-desktop/docs2-gateway/docs2-memory bundles. py_compile of both docstring files OK; scripts/run_tests.sh tests/gateway/test_late_plugin_rewire.py tests/tui_gateway/test_plugins_manage_late_activation.py -q -> 6 passed.
evidence.source: hermes_cli/plugins_activation.py:96-128 activate_plugin_now -> load_and_go_live (:130-173) sets activation['live_now'] = {'mcp_servers', 'skills'} and drops mcp_servers from deferred (:161-163); gateway/run_plugin_rewire.py:81-118 reload-plugins verb only rediscovers and rewires; tools/mcp_tool_config.py:431 discovery (hence /reload-mcp) includes portable plugin servers; no 'mcp.reload' RPC exists (tui_gateway/contracts/tools_mcp_plugins.py:137 is 'reload.mcp').
